title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora on 06.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 06/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 06.10.2026 ;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 06/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-04/2026
It is hereby notified that on 06.10.2026 ;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora would not be available for
Judicial as well as Administrative work.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K.
Vishen and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora and
Hon’ble Mr. Justice R.T.Vachhani.)
(3) Hon’ble Mr. Justice R. T. Vachhani would sit Single and take
up the matters at Sr. No.24 to Sr. No. 74 notified before
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice S. V. Pinto.)
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
